other_conditions: Must belong to listed OBC communities (Banjara, Baladiya, Labana, Gadia‑Lohar, Gadolia, Gujar, Gurjar, Raika, Raibari (Debasi), Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari) with certification issued by Tehsildar or a higher‑level revenue officer
Student must be a full‑time student; employed students must take leave without pay for the entire course
All children of the same parent/guardian are eligible
Educational level from class 11 up to PhD
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of maintenance allowance and fee for the duration of the course.
